## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Related Issue

Link the approved issue or proposal.

## Verification

List the exact commands and manual checks performed, with their results.

## Visual Evidence

For user-interface or artwork changes, include representative before-and-after
images and describe scaling, contrast, and accessibility checks.

## Licensing and Provenance

Identify new dependencies, assets, fonts, references, generation tools, and
licenses. Write `Not applicable` only when the change introduces none.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactoring.
- [ ] Relevant builds and tests pass.
- [ ] User-facing strings remain aligned across all 18 localization files.
- [ ] Save compatibility, accessibility, privacy, and offline behavior were
      considered.
- [ ] No credentials, signing material, generated packages, WACK output, or
      private information are included.
- [ ] Store and README claims still distinguish shipped features from future
      plans.
- [ ] New or changed artwork has editable sources and documented provenance.
- [ ] I have the right to submit the contribution under the stated license.
